implementationSteps.description: Future task defines adapter output models and validation checks, still file-protocol JSON only.
failStop: Stop if the model would bypass Phase 8 review.
Stop if it claims final media approval.

implementationSteps.description: Future task maps Phase 8-approved plan data into adapter metadata with strict fail-stop checks.
acceptance: Manifest generation only if explicitly assigned later.

implementationSteps.description: Future task adds happy-path and fail-stop tests for adapter implementation.
acceptance: Tests prove manifest boundary is explicit.
failStop: Stop if tests require ffmpeg/TTS/provider tools.

implementationSteps.description: Future task sends adapter implementation result to a local JSON review gate before renderer dry-run.

riskChecklist.risk: Planning notes could be mistaken for an actual ComicVideoRenderHandoffManifest.
riskChecklist.mitigation: Keep manifestGenerated=false and planningOnly=true in every Phase 8 output.
riskChecklist.failStop: Stop if a future slice generates manifest JSON without explicit 01/user assignment.

riskChecklist.risk: A PASS plan could be misread as renderer readiness or MP4 readiness.
riskChecklist.mitigation: Keep downstream boundary to implementation review only and state no media generation.
riskChecklist.failStop: Stop if docs or output claim final video, MP4 readiness, or renderer readiness.

riskChecklist.risk: Voice/prompt planning could drift into external provider or TTS invocation.
riskChecklist.failStop: Stop if any provider/API/TTS command is introduced.
